data.body: AC amendment: test_ux_probe_named_symbol must assert SKILL.md contains dimension ID tokens from ux-probe-set.md (criticality, non_happy_path, flow_entry_exit), and that the bare phrase 'UX probe' alone in SKILL.md is insufficient — the named dimension IDs must appear. This ensures DD4 has a failing RED assertion that forces Task 2 to embed the specific dimension IDs, not just generic probe language.
